title: SCP-1048, The Builder Bear
description: Be careful if you find a teddy bear...
body:
The Builder Bear adds a new monster. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-1048, also known as The Builder Bear.


At first, SCP-1048 may seem like a cute teddy bear. It will show you pictures or even dance around in a playful manner, giving no indication of the dangers it hides. But don’t let its adorable appearance fool you. There are three hostile variants of this creature that will make you rethink your comfort with teddy bears. 

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-1048 spawn?

SCP-1048 can spawn anywhere in the overworld like a normal monster. However, there can only be one instance of SCP-1048.

</details>



![SCP-1048](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dedd6dba3b25cd62bf3eed403d9124af8bbf1dae.png)

SCP-1048 is a small, seemingly innocent teddy bear that appears friendly and harmless. If you right-click SCP-1048, it can either dance adorably or show you a picture with a smiling face. However, if you decide to attack SCP-1048, it can spawn dangerous variants of itself:
